user.title: XRAS geomagnetic activity
user.description:
Data by the Solar Astronomy Laboratory, IKI RAS (xras.ru).

Enter a region name from the XRAS catalog (for example Moscow, Riga, Krasnodar or New York), a Latin slug such as saint_petersburg, or the API code directly: RAL5, RIK0, UP03.

error.cannot_connect: Could not download or parse XRAS data. Check the connection and try again.
error.invalid_region: Region not found. Check the spelling, use the Latin slug from the XRAS page URL, or enter the API code directly.
error.ambiguous_region: More than one XRAS region has this name. Enter the Latin slug or API code to disambiguate it.

init.title: Polling settings
init.description: The region is fixed for this entry. To use another region, remove this entry and add a new one.
